none: PAS NLM-9EB777: Roman Coin: Denarius of Geta
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Silver Coin. Denarius of Geta (209-212) as Caesar, issue of 203-208, mint of Rome, cf. RIC volume 4 part 1 nos 26 [reverse] and 27 [obverse]. Obverse description: Youthful bust draped right. Obverse inscription: GETACAES PONTCOS. Reverse description: Geta as priest standing left pouring incense over tripod burner. Reverse inscription; VOTA PVBLICA. Diameter: 17.9mm, Weight: 2.39gms, die axis: 12
